meta.verification: Claim-by-claim review against primary authorities and provider-published terms. Retrieval mode is disclosed; this is not a legal opinion or a guarantee that every source remains unchanged.
meta.official_definition: government = issuing authority/regulator/government-hosted primary text or FAQ; provider_primary = the provider itself, never labelled government.

sources.title: Regulation on Foreign Exchange Administration
sources.issuer: State Council / Ministry of Justice republication
sources.claim: Current-account payments require a real lawful transaction; capital-account payments follow their own approval/documentation rules. Private FX dealing and deceptive transfers can attract penalties.
sources.excerpt: 经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础。
sources.limitations: The regulation is not a retail fee schedule or a personal tax calculation.

sources.title: Current Account Foreign Exchange Business Guidelines (2020)
sources.claim: The USD 50,000 convenience purchase quota is for domestic individuals; documented lawful RMB current-account income of an overseas individual follows Article 59. Permanent-residence-card holders have a different rule. Splitting to evade controls is prohibited.
sources.excerpt: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。
sources.limitations: Bank classification and documentary review still apply. This is not permission to relabel savings as salary.

sources.title: Lawful RMB remuneration earned in China by an overseas individual
sources.claim: An overseas individual may purchase FX against identity and transaction-value source materials, including tax evidence, for lawful current-account RMB income earned in China.
sources.excerpt: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。
sources.limitations: Does not establish this user’s classification, income source or bank acceptance.

sources.title: Current-account income: tax evidence and permitted destinations
sources.claim: Where the lawful income is not taxable under the rules, a tax voucher need not be supplied. Purchased FX may be remitted, deposited to the person’s FX account or carried out subject to the applicable rules.
sources.excerpt: 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入按规定无需纳税的，购汇可以不提供税务凭证。
sources.limitations: Non-taxable status must be established; it cannot be assumed from citizenship.

sources.title: Further facilitation of personal current-account FX business
sources.claim: Banks check consistency of purchase and payment purpose. Repeat lawful salary purchases at the same bank during a valid employment contract may avoid repeated review of duplicate materials.
sources.excerpt: 对于在华工作境外个人劳动合同有效期内到同一银行再次办理合法薪酬收入购汇，银行可根据首次办理情况，免于审核重复性材料。
sources.limitations: Facilitation does not remove the underlying lawful-income requirement.

sources.title: Definition of emigrant and inheritance property transfers
sources.claim: Emigrant transfer concerns lawful mainland property owned before acquiring the relevant emigrant status. Inheritance transfer concerns qualifying foreign/HK/Macao/Taiwan heirs.
sources.excerpt: 移民转移是指从中国内地移居外国，或者赴香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区及台湾地区定居的自然人，将其在取得移民身份之前在中国境内拥有的合法财产变现。
sources.limitations: US citizenship alone does not establish a former mainland household registration or qualifying pre-emigration ownership.

sources.title: Where to apply for a personal property transfer
sources.locator: 2026 property-transfer FAQ 07, citing 2024 capital guidelines section 6.4
sources.claim: Emigrant applications go to the former household-registration SAFE office; inheritance applications to the decedent’s former household-registration office. Different decedents’ inheritances may be combined at one of those offices.
sources.excerpt: 移民财产转移由移民原户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。继承财产转移由被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。
sources.limitations: This FAQ verifies the filing location, not every documentary requirement in section 6.4.

sources.title: Approved property-transfer funds must be remitted directly
sources.claim: After conversion, the bank must remit directly to the applicant’s own account in the country/region of residence; domestic withdrawal of the foreign cash is not permitted.
sources.excerpt: 应直接将外汇汇往移民或继承人居住国或地区申请人本人账户，不得在境内提取外币现钞。
sources.limitations: A third-party destination or domestic cash withdrawal is not this route.

sources.title: Beijing personal FX business guide
sources.claim: The March 2024 local guide lists identity, source/title, tax and agency materials for emigrant/inheritance transfers, a 20-working-day complete-application processing period, and no SAFE administrative fee.
sources.excerpt: 审批收费依据及标准：不收费
sources.limitations: Local guide; confirm the competent office and current checklist. The fee is SAFE’s administrative fee, not bank, notarisation, translation or tax cost.

sources.title: Capital-account policy adjustments: personal property transfers
sources.claim: The 2014 circular removed the RMB 500,000 reporting requirement, allowed lump-sum or batches within an approval, and removed certain notarisation requirements.
sources.excerpt: the bank may remit the relevant funds in a lump sum or in several batches within the limit specified in the approval document.
sources.limitations: English is reference-only; later rules and the local office control. Older staged-release descriptions are not assumed current.

sources.title: House-sale proceeds: purchase of FX and outward remittance
sources.issuer: Shanghai municipal government, attributed to Bank of China
sources.claim: A nonresident seller is described as able to remit sale proceeds after transfer registration and tax steps, using ID, transfer contract/registration and tax voucher; an external-payment filing form is described above USD 50,000.
sources.excerpt: Tax Filing Form for External Payments for Trade in Services and Other Account is also required if the transaction amount exceeds $50,000
sources.limitations: Government-hosted bank FAQ, not the underlying regulation; local practice and inherited-property cases need separate confirmation.

sources.title: External-payment tax filing: supplementary announcement explained
sources.claim: For covered payments, the threshold remains above USD 50,000 per payment; the same contract generally needs filing only before its first covered payment. Online filing is available.
sources.excerpt: 未超过等值5万美元的单笔对外支付无需进行税务备案。
sources.limitations: Filing is not a tax rate. Coverage and exemptions depend on the payment; do not split payments to evade review.

sources.title: Foreign employees participating in mainland-listed equity incentives
sources.claim: The listed company handles registration. Sale/dividend proceeds can be remitted or converted into the employee’s domestic FX account against the registration certificate, matching ID and broker evidence.
sources.excerpt: 可凭以下材料在银行办理汇出或购汇划转
sources.limitations: Only qualifying registered plan proceeds; not a wrapper for unrelated savings or securities trading.

sources.title: Bank of China service-price index
sources.claim: The current index distinguishes personal tariffs from corporate tariffs and links the personal-finance schedule used here.
sources.excerpt: 本价目表自2025年11月11日起实施
sources.limitations: Provider-published tariff, not a government tax. Recheck before execution.

sources.title: Bank of China personal-finance tariff
sources.claim: Personal cross-border TT/draft: 0.1%, CNY 50 minimum and CNY 260 maximum; international cable CNY 150. USD full-arrival correspondent charge: USD 15 via BOC New York, otherwise USD 25. Current Great Wall debit-card overseas ATM fee: CNY 12 + 1%, capped at CNY 112.
sources.excerpt: 电汇/票汇按汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔
sources.limitations: Conditional tariff arithmetic only. FX rate, receiving-bank charges, eligibility, taxes and actual routing are not established. Foreign-bank charges otherwise actual.

sources.title: Bank of China USD reference board
sources.claim: Extracted spot buying 666.48 and spot selling 669.29 CNY per USD 100; middle 671.68. The board says actual online/branch transaction rates control.
sources.excerpt: 客户办理结/购汇业务时，应以中国银行网上银行、手机银行、智能柜台或网点柜台实际交易汇率为准
sources.limitations: Snapshot date is later than the report date of 2026-11-08 UTC. Not an executable quote; timezone was not established. Used only in explicitly conditional arithmetic.

sources.title: Treasury reporting rates of exchange, September 2026
sources.claim: The reporting rate is CNY 6.7050 per USD 1.
sources.excerpt: China-Renminbi | 6.7050 | 9/30/2026
sources.limitations: Reporting benchmark, not a retail conversion quote; online amendments are not included in the PDF.

sources.title: Standard Chartered China personal-banking tariff, Version 2
sources.locator: Item 14, online/mobile overseas transfer; general notes
sources.claim: Electronic overseas transfer: Personal CNY 100 + 120 + 200 OUR intermediary; Ease 0 + 120 + 200; Priority 0 + 0 + 200; Priority Private 0 + 0 + 0.
sources.excerpt: 每笔人民币100元
sources.limitations: Provider-primary, not government. OUR does not guarantee against every beneficiary-side deduction. Tier eligibility, FX quote, taxes and receiving fees remain unknown.

sources.title: Standard Chartered China overseas-remittance service
sources.locator: Electronic-transfer fee table, OUR explanation, steps 1–6
sources.claim: The service supports overseas transfers and explains SHA/BEN/OUR. Global Link’s listed destinations do not include the US; ordinary overseas transfer is the relevant product.
sources.excerpt: 如发生海外收款行入账费用或收款行的海外中转行费用，取决于海外银行的操作
sources.limitations: Published service information is not an account-specific quote or guarantee of full arrival.

sources.title: Wise guide to CNY transfers
sources.locator: Sending from CNY: eligibility, recipients and limits
sources.claim: Non-mainland individuals with qualifying China work/tax records may send to their own overseas account. Current help lists CNY 300,000 per China-bank-app transfer and CNY 50,000 via Alipay; overall limit depends on documented income/tax.
sources.excerpt: you can only send CNY from China to another account you own
sources.limitations: Provider-primary, not a government rule or a fee quote. The page contains an older year-example; obtain current product verification. Salary savings only, not arbitrary capital.

sources.title: Wise China blog: send money to and from China
sources.claim: The blog says CNY 100,000 per transaction, conflicting with the current help centre’s channel-specific limits.
sources.excerpt: a limit of 100,000 CNY per transaction
sources.limitations: Used only to document the conflict; the help centre is preferred and the discrepancy is flagged.

sources.title: Overseas cash withdrawals with mainland bank cards
sources.claim: All cards of one person are aggregated at CNY 100,000 equivalent per calendar year; each card has a CNY 10,000 daily limit. Borrowing cards to evade the limit is prohibited. Ordinary overseas card spending is distinct.
sources.excerpt: 本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。
sources.limitations: Not a USD 10,000–400,000 repatriation channel. ATM operator fees and card-specific FX rates are unknown.

sources.title: Future BOC ATM tariff change
sources.claim: A announced change distinguishes UnionPay from Mastercard/VISA overseas withdrawals, but takes effect after this report date.
sources.excerpt: 将于2026年11月11日起实施
sources.limitations: Not applied to the 2026-11-08 scenarios.

sources.title: Carrying foreign currency cash into and out of China
sources.issuer: SAFE / General Administration of Customs, State Council Gazette
sources.claim: Without a controlling prior entry declaration, up to USD 5,000 equivalent needs no carry permit; above USD 5,000 through USD 10,000 needs a bank permit; above USD 10,000 is exceptional and needs SAFE approval.
sources.excerpt: 出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元的外币现钞出境
sources.limitations: Frequent-traveller rules differ. A permit is not a way to split large transfers. Travel, security and destination rules remain relevant.

sources.title: Money and other monetary instruments
sources.locator: Reporting threshold, who files, monetary instruments
sources.claim: More than USD 10,000 in covered currency/monetary instruments transported into or out of the US must be reported on FinCEN Form 105; family/group aggregation applies.
sources.excerpt: the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual
sources.limitations: Reporting is not a tax. Ordinary bank wires are not physical carriage; instrument definitions matter.

sources.title: Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect
sources.claim: WMC is a closed-loop, quota-managed investment channel for eligible Greater Bay Area residents, not a general unrestricted outward remittance account.
sources.excerpt: Cross-boundary renminbi fund flows are subject to closed-loop and quota management.
sources.limitations: US citizenship alone is not eligibility. Product, residency and quota conditions must be checked.

sources.title: WMC Southbound Scheme
sources.claim: Paired dedicated accounts carry RMB through CIPS. Withdrawals of principal/proceeds return to the mainland remittance account; offshore currency conversion is for eligible investment purposes.
sources.excerpt: the dedicated remittance account is the only source of investment principal remitted to the dedicated investment account and the only account to which funds are remitted back
sources.limitations: Not a route to freely deposit USD in a US account. Product fees and investment risk are not quoted here.

sources.title: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC
sources.claim: Residence/domicile and income source matter. Comprehensive income has 3–45% rates; asset-transfer gains generally 20% after basis/reasonable expenses. Basic pension/retirement pay under uniform state provisions is exempt. Emigration household cancellation triggers a filing obligation.
sources.excerpt: the amount of taxable income shall be the balance after deduction of the original value of the asset and reasonable expenses
sources.limitations: Statutory rates are not this person’s tax bill. Exemptions, treaty positions, residence history and prior compliance are unknown.

sources.title: Temporary IIT exemption for savings-deposit interest
sources.issuer: MOF / STA, Shanghai tax bureau republication
sources.locator: Caishui [2008] No.132; page status full text effective
sources.claim: Savings-deposit interest accrued from 2008-10-09 is temporarily exempt from IIT under the published notice.
sources.excerpt: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税。
sources.limitations: Do not generalise to every investment product, foreign account or US tax. The notice concerns the described savings-deposit interest.

sources.title: US citizens and resident aliens abroad
sources.claim: US citizens generally report worldwide income. Foreign gifts/bequests above USD 100,000 from a nonresident alien individual/foreign estate can require Form 3520 reporting.
sources.excerpt: You are subject to tax on worldwide income from all sources
sources.limitations: Reporting thresholds are not tax rates. Trust, entity, pension and gift characterisation can change the result.

sources.title: Foreign tax credit
sources.locator: Qualifying taxes; how to claim; compliance issues
sources.claim: Qualifying foreign income taxes on the same income may be credited or deducted. No credit for tax on excluded income; treaty-reduced tax can limit the creditable amount.
sources.excerpt: you cannot take a foreign tax credit for taxes on income you exclude
sources.limitations: Not an automatic dollar-for-dollar refund. Form 1116, category, sourcing and limitation rules matter.

sources.title: Foreign tax credit: how to figure the credit
sources.claim: The credit is limited by the US tax attributable to foreign-source taxable income; unused qualifying tax may be carried back one year and forward ten, subject to the rules.
sources.excerpt: Your foreign tax credit is the amount of foreign tax you paid or accrued or, if smaller, the foreign tax credit limit.
sources.limitations: No personal credit amount can be computed without the return facts.

sources.title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
sources.locator: Who must file; when and how to file
sources.claim: A US person reports qualifying foreign accounts if their aggregate value exceeded USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year. FinCEN Form 114 is separate from the income-tax return.
sources.excerpt: the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year
sources.limitations: Account exceptions and maximum values require facts. Penalty amounts are inflation-adjusted and are not assumed here.

sources.title: Summary of FATCA reporting for US taxpayers
sources.claim: Form 8938 thresholds depend on residence/filing status. US-resident unmarried: above USD 50,000 year-end or 75,000 any time; qualifying abroad unmarried: above 200,000 year-end or 300,000 any time. Joint thresholds double.
sources.excerpt: FATCA requires certain U.S. taxpayers who hold foreign financial assets with an aggregate value of more than the reporting threshold
sources.limitations: The IRS abroad definition is specific; a transfer amount alone does not establish the filing obligation. FBAR may also apply.

sources.title: US–China income-tax treaty technical explanation
sources.locator: Article 1 discussion of Protocol paragraph 2; Article 22
sources.claim: The saving clause preserves US taxation of citizens/residents, subject to specified exceptions. The treaty is not a general exemption for US citizens.
sources.excerpt: preserves the right of the United States to tax its citizens and residents under its domestic law
sources.limitations: Treaty residence, income article and current law must be reviewed for the actual case.

sources.title: Publication 525: personal foreign-currency transactions
sources.claim: The official search excerpt states that a personal foreign-currency gain is not included unless more than USD 200; above that it is reported as a capital gain.
sources.excerpt: If the gain is more than $200, report it as a capital gain.
sources.limitations: The targeted passage was returned in an official-source search excerpt; full-page chunk retrievals exposed navigation/other sections. Treat the precise application as needing manual confirmation; no personal gain is calculated.
sources.retrieval: official search excerpt; targeted full-body passage not isolated

sources.title: Instructions for Form 720, June 2026
sources.claim: A 1% excise tax applies to certain remittance transfers after 2025 when funded with cash, money order, cashier’s check or a similar physical instrument; providers collect/report it.
sources.excerpt: The 1% remittance transfer tax applies to certain remittances when the sender makes the transaction with cash, a money order, a cashier’s check, or a similar physical instrument.
sources.limitations: This is not a blanket 1% tax on money arriving from China. Direction, provider and funding instrument must be established.
sources.retrieval: HTML chunk 9 plus official search excerpt

sources.title: Notice on virtual-currency and related risks, Yinfa [2026] No.42
sources.claim: Mainland fiat/virtual-currency exchange and related business are prohibited illegal financial activity; the notice repeals the 2021 No.237 notice.
sources.excerpt: 中国人民银行等十部门《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。
sources.limitations: Do not recommend a CNY–USDT–USD workaround. This is a legal exclusion, not a cost estimate.

sources.title: QDII overseas securities investment FX rules
sources.claim: QDII is an approved institutional quota channel. Individual money enters a product/custody structure; redemption/dividend FX can return to domestic individual FX accounts under the rules. It is not a personal offshore cash account.
sources.excerpt: 合格投资者可以自有资金或募集境内机构和个人资金，投资于法规及相关部门允许的境外市场及产品
sources.limitations: Product fees, quota availability and redemption terms are not quoted. Do not treat QDII as unrestricted repatriation.

sources.title: Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect key features
sources.locator: 2014 presentation: closed-loop fund flow; southbound eligibility/currency
sources.claim: The operator’s introductory presentation describes southbound Stock Connect as a closed-loop trading link, with RMB between mainland brokers and ChinaClear and HKD at the HK side.
sources.excerpt: Closed Loop Cross-Boundary Fund Flow to Achieve Stringent Risk Management
sources.limitations: Historical 2014 presentation. Current eligibility, quotas, fees and product scope were not verified; no numeric current limit is published here.
